*Sanidassanattika, Saṁkiliṭṭhattika* (Patthana 17.31) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. In the systematic classification scheme of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text investigates the matrix of conditional relations arising from the combination of the visible triad (*sanidassanattika*) with the defilement triad (*saṁkiliṭṭhattika*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral does not record any modern English translation for this section [SuttaCentral].
